name: Relace Apply 3
title: Relace Apply 3: price, context window and specs
answer: Relace Apply 3 is a model in Relace's Relace family, first listed on 2025-09-26. It takes text in and returns text, with a context window of 256K tokens and up to 128K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.85 per million input tokens and $1.25 per million output tokens. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API.
compare: It is the oldest of the 2 versions of Relace still listed.
Its input price is below the family median of $1 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
